evals.name: implement
evals.prompt: Mount a conversation for each selected topic. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: Use the public ChatConversation component for a single conversation. The host owns topic selection, ordered messages and command outcomes; a send callback is intent, not proof of delivery.
assertions: Keep one stable topic id per message and render only the selected topic. Done: switching to Notes replaces the Books transcript.

Capture the topic before awaiting the write. Append a confirmed response only to its original topic, or leave an observed query as the sole message source. Done: late responses cannot migrate to the currently open conversation.

evals.prompt: A rejected chat message shows up as delivered. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: If a rejected message looks delivered, check whether the composer updated host history before persistence completed. Keep transient errors indexed by topic, not in a shared last-error string.
